content.title: Single-source creative response
content.summary: Contribute a text source, receive one non-self source, and respond independently.
content.setup: Enroll a fixed group; each participant may contribute one source.
content.prompt: Describe an image or idea in text.
content.participant: Respond to the one source assigned to you before the window closes.
content.completion: Reveal accepted source-response pairs; missing responses do not block the deadline.
content.access: Your assigned source and response are private until the explicit result reveal.

provenance.credit: Harmonomicon digital example; the runbook defines the selected software rules.
